notes.title: Bug Fixes 5/29/2021
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your bug reports!

I have managed to update and applied fixes to more content that you were able to share with me.

1.) Siege weapons didn't want to leave the barracks. (fixed)
2.) Research would stop upon loading from previous patch updates. (fixed)
3.) Reduced size of video files and recoded them to be more efficient when viewing as some said they stopped the game. (potentially fixed, could not recreate issue after changes)
4.) Fixed graphics with research items completed upon loading the game. (fixed)
5.) Updated Help Tip UI for hero menu to see what each image represents. (fixed)
6.) Moved Hero Menu to bottom left-hand corner to provide a better visual appeal verses in the mid left-bottom area.
7.) Provided more save/load database system updates per fix 2.), save/load state of games may be effected.

Sincerely Thank You All,

Ryan Anderson | Amnon Entertainment, LLC

notes.title: Bug fixes & Quality of Life updates 5/27/2021
notes.notes:
Workers were being duplicated upon closing and re-entering the UI to recruit more causing an infinite amount of workers. (fixed.)
Updated UI to select/deselect research items as well as worker recruitment.
Research was halt upon closing the research UI. (fixed)

Updated Save/Load systems to accommodate for multi queing for research with multiple citadel buildings.
Warning: (Previous saved games may not work; however, I've tested out as much as possible and it was working for my old saved games).

Thank you for your messages for these bugs.

Sincerely,

Ryan Anderson | Amnon Entertainment, LLC

notes.title: Bug Fixes 5/27/2021
notes.notes:

1.a) When hovering over a UI certain building UI's will disappear when selecting on an image or other areas if canceling a que order.

2.) fixed more than one barracks will produce recruits and demonstrate progression in UI.
3.) fixed more than one city hall will produce workers and demonstrate progression in UI.
4.) Barracks Text help tip in Research UI was blank, and is fixed now.

5.) Quality of Life Improvements
5.a) In the settings UI you can adjust movement speed & scroll wheel movement speed

Thank you for your efforts in providing me this information.

Sincerely,

Ryan Anderson | Amnon Entertainment

notes.title: Patch 5/24/2021
notes.notes:
1.) Added Additional Video Tutorials.
2.) Added (E,R,F) keyboard keys as an alternative for laptop users to maneuver the world
3.) Enhanced the troop selection and the UI will expand/contrast depending on how many troops have been selected, troop selection will disappear when clicking on buildings or the land; instead of, persist constantly
4.) Removed secondary cameras from hero character

Thank you to all for your support, and helping with certain bug corrections that I did not foresee.

Sincerely,

Ryan | Amnon Entertainment
